title: tapper user/project config
description: Schema for tapper user or project configuration.

keg.description: KEG reference. Precedence: --keg, TAP_KEG, project keg, matching kegMap.keg, user keg.

flight.description: Flight reference (@namespace/+slug, +slug, or bare slug). Precedence: --flight, TAP_FLIGHT, project flight, matching kegMap.flight, user flight.

hub.description: Saved Hub name. Precedence: --hub, TAP_HUB, project hub, matching kegMap.hub, user hub, alphabetically first configured Hub, built-in Atlas unless disabled. All KEGs resolve within this Hub.

disableAtlasHub.description: When true, the synthesized built-in atlas hub (https://atlas.foldwise.ai) is suppressed: it is not synthesized, is omitted from hub listings, and is skipped in hub resolution, so hub-dependent commands fail with a clear error if no other hub is configured. An explicit atlas entry in hubs{} is unaffected. Override with TAP_DISABLE_ATLAS_HUB env var (1/true/yes/on).

disableTelemetry.description: When true, disables privacy-minimized Tap CLI and MCP invocation reporting. Reporting is enabled by default and can also be disabled with TAP_DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1.

kegMap.description: Startup-directory defaults. First matching regex wins; otherwise longest directory prefix wins, with ties in configuration order. Exactly one rule supplies defaults beneath project config.

items.description: Any combination of KEG, Hub, and flight defaults. Omitted fields fall back independently to user config.

pathPrefix.description: Directory prefix; matches the directory itself and descendants, never a partial directory name.

pathRegex.description: Regular expression used to match the current path.

keg.description: Optional KEG reference. Overridden by project keg, TAP_KEG, or --keg.

hub.description: Optional saved Hub name, overridden by project hub, TAP_HUB, or --hub.

flight.description: Optional flight reference, overridden by project flight, TAP_FLIGHT, or --flight. Empty does not clear an inherited flight.

hubs.description: Saved Hub connections, allowed only in user configuration.

token.description: Inline token credential for hub access.

tokenEnv.description: Environment variable name containing the hub token.

relay.description: Configures `tap relay`: which local or personal model providers this machine contributes to Hub's model catalog. Holds provider access and nothing else — model identity comes from the Hub catalog. Allowed only in user configuration; project layers are stripped.

enabled.description: false makes `tap relay` refuse to start while keeping the rest of the block. Omitted means enabled.

name.description: Identifies the relay to Hub and prefixes its catalog ids (<relay>/<provider>/<model>). Defaults to a name derived from the hostname; `tap relay --name` overrides it.

hubs.description: Names from hubs to serve at once, each over its own connection with the same providers. Omitted means the one hub login resolution picks; `tap relay --hub` narrows to one.

providers.description: Model providers the relay reaches, keyed by the provider name advertised to Hub.

additionalProperties.description: How the relay reaches one model provider.

kind.description: Provider adapter. Defaults to the provider's key, so a provider named ollama needs no kind.

baseUrl.description: OpenAI-compatible API base URL, including /v1. Defaults per kind: http://127.0.0.1:11434/v1 for ollama, https://api.openai.com/v1 for openai, https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 for openrouter. Required for openai-compatible.

auth.description: How the relay authenticates to the provider. 'none' sends no credential (local providers such as Ollama). 'apiKey' sends the key read from the variable named by apiKeyEnv. Defaults to apiKey for openai and openrouter, none otherwise.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable holding the API key — the name is configured, never the secret, mirroring hubs.*.tokenEnv. Defaults to OPENAI_API_KEY for openai and OPENROUTER_API_KEY for openrouter. The key stays in the relay process and never reaches Hub.

maxConcurrent.description: This provider's in-flight requests across every hub the relay serves. Defaults to 4.

priority.description: This provider's rank on Hub, lower preferred, both in the model list and when a pool picks a source. Omitted means unranked, after every ranked provider.

models.description: Which of the provider's models are offered to Hub, resolved against the provider's own model list.

allow.description: Model ids or path.Match glob patterns (e.g. qwen3*) to offer. Empty offers every model not denied.

deny.description: Model ids or path.Match glob patterns never to offer. Deny wins over allow.

transcription.description: Model ids or path.Match glob patterns that turn speech into text through the provider's /audio/transcriptions endpoint. Offered for dictation, not chat; exact ids are offered even when the provider's /models omits them.

logFile.description: Path to the log output file. Override with TAP_LOG_FILE env var.

logLevel.description: Log verbosity level (debug, info, warn, error). Override with TAP_LOG_LEVEL env var.
